topic.title: Green Belt / Grey Belt / Golden Rules
topic.source_contract: Green Belt designation and purpose, grey-belt definition, plan or decision route, previously developed land, accessibility, affordable housing contribution, infrastructure, accessible green space, viability, planning obligations, decision, delivery and monitoring evidence

scope_guards: A Green Belt location is not proof that development is prohibited or acceptable.
A grey-belt label is not an adopted allocation or permission.
Previously developed land status is not proof of deliverability.
A policy contribution expectation is not an executed planning obligation.
Viability evidence is not accepted merely because it was submitted.
A committee resolution is not a completed legal agreement.
Permission is not completed construction or occupied development.
No score or promotion is written without exact-site policy, decision, agreement, delivery and monitoring evidence.
